title: Warm temperature-induced autophagy mediates selective degradation of TIMING OF CAB EXPRESSION 1 thus promoting plant thermomorphogenesis.
authors: Li, Baolei; Wang, Panpan; Sun, Fan; Qin, Jing; Zhao, Xiaojing; Yu, Xinyue; Su, Zhen; Mao, Tonglin; Wang, Xiangfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究温度诱导的自噬降解TOC1蛋白调控植物热形态建成，属于植物信号通路与蛋白降解机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Plant thermomorphogenesis is a critical adaptive response to elevated ambient temperatures. The transcription factor PHYTOCHROME-INTERACTING FACTOR 4 (PIF4) integrates diverse environmental and phytohormone signals to coordinate thermoresponsive growth. However, the cellular mechanisms underlying plant thermomorphogenic growth remain poorly understood. In this study, we show that elevated ambient temperature activates autophagy in a PIF4-dependent manner. The autophagy-deficient mutants autophagy-related 5 (atg5)-1 and autophagy-related 7 (atg7)-2 exhibit shorter hypocotyls compared with the wild type at 28  degrees C, highlighting the important role of autophagy in regulating thermomorphogenic growth in Arabidopsis (Arabidopsis thaliana). Moreover, we identified TIMING OF CAB EXPRESSION 1 (TOC1), a negative regulator of PIF4, as a target of selective autophagy. TOC1 directly interacts with AUTOPHAGY-RELATED 8 (ATG8) via the conserved ATG8-interacting motif-LIR/AIM docking site interface and is degraded through the autophagy pathway in response to elevated temperature. TOC1 accumulates in the autophagy-deficient mutant atg5-1 at 28  degrees C, where it inhibits PIF4 function and reduces thermosensitivity. Conversely, the reduced TOC1 level in atg5-1 toc1-21 rescues the short-hypocotyl phenotype of atg5-1 at 28  degrees C. Our study demonstrates that warm temperature-induced autophagy promotes plant thermomorphogenic growth by mediating the selective degradation of TOC1. This study reveals the reciprocal regulation between autophagy and thermomorphogenic signaling and identifies a molecular mechanism underlying this crosstalk.
abstract_zh: 植物热形态建成是对环境温度升高的关键适应性反应。转录因子PHYTOCHROME-INTERACTING FACTOR 4 (PIF4)整合多种环境与植物激素信号以协调热响应生长。然而，植物热形态建成生长的细胞机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们表明升高的环境温度以PIF4依赖的方式激活自噬。自噬缺陷突变体autophagy-related 5 (atg5)-1和autophagy-related 7 (atg7)-2在28摄氏度下与野生型相比表现出较短的下胚轴，突显了自噬在调控拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）热形态建成生长中的重要作用。此外，我们鉴定了TIMING OF CAB EXPRESSION 1 (TOC1)，一个PIF4的负调控因子，作为选择性自噬的靶标。TOC1通过保守的ATG8相互作用基序-LIR/AIM对接位点界面直接与AUTOPHAGY-RELATED 8 (ATG8)相互作用，并在响应升高的温度时通过自噬途径被降解。TOC1在自噬缺陷突变体atg5-1中于28摄氏度下积累，在此处它抑制PIF4功能并降低热敏感性。相反，atg5-1 toc1-21中降低的TOC1水平在28摄氏度下挽救了atg5-1的短下胚轴表型。我们的研究表明，温暖温度诱导的自噬通过介导TOC1的选择性降解促进植物热形态建成生长。本研究揭示了自噬与热形态建成信号之间的相互调控，并鉴定了这种串扰的分子机制。
